title: An accretive discipline. Replication package: a multi-source corpus of 29 general linguistics journals (1854-2025) with framework/method classification, method volumes, and Glottolog-resolved language coverage
description:
Anonymised deposit for double-anonymous peer review. Author and affiliation are withheld and will be added on acceptance.

Replication package for the study Is linguistics one field? Division, method and the empirical base of a century of general linguistics journals, in ten-discipline comparison.

Corpus. 29 English-language generalist linguistics journals selected by ISSN (Language, Linguistic Inquiry, Journal of Linguistics, Lingua, Linguistics, NLLT, Glossa, Cognitive Linguistics, Studies in Language, Linguistic Typology, Language Sciences, Folia Linguistica, The Linguistic Review, Theoretical Linguistics, WORD, Transactions of the Philological Society, Canadian Journal of Linguistics, Australian Journal of Linguistics, Nordic Journal of Linguistics, Studia Linguistica, STUF, Linguistics and Philosophy, Linguistics Vanguard, Lingvisticae Investigationes, Acta Linguistica Hafniensia, Functions of Language, Language and Cognition, Language Dynamics and Change, Open Linguistics), 1854-2025. 61,525 OpenAlex records fused with Crossref and Semantic Scholar; 32,781 research articles after a documented review-and-paratext filter; 128,719 in-corpus citation edges.

Contents. the cleaned article table; full Crossref-deposited reference lists; per-article two-axis orientation labels (framework: generative vs functional; method: introspective / experimental / corpus / descriptive / computational) with the seed lexicons and classifier report; per-article Leiden module membership; per-article extracted language mentions resolved to Glottolog, with the rarefied diversity tables, the title-only control series and the hand-coded precision sample; all derived tables behind every figure; the complete pipeline and analysis code; the figures; and the manuscript and supplement.
